title: Review: loadng.rs edge cases 2026-08-16
description:
Review confidence: 85% chance of missed bug.

Least confident areas:
- Interaction with link layer signature verification (assumed correct per SECURITY comments)
- Protocol spec compliance (flags, error_codes - did not cross-reference LOADng RFC)
- Concurrent usage patterns if RouteDiscovery is used from multiple threads

Would raise confidence if:
- Cross-reference with LOADng RFC for flag/error_code definitions
- Review integration with link layer signature verification
- Check if any code constructs Rreq with hop_limit > 15

Summary:
- P0: 0 findings
- P1: 0 findings  
- P2: 2 findings (hop_limit write asymmetry, ring_index overflow theoretical)
- P3: 4 findings (validation, documentation)
- Good: 4 findings (seq freshness, hop clamping, typestate, signature requirement)

The code is well-written with comprehensive edge case handling. The typestate pattern and security comments demonstrate careful design. No critical bugs found.
close_reason: Invalid: All findings closed. P2 findings were based on incorrect analysis - .1 claimed asymmetric clamping but neither from_bytes nor write_to clamps (both symmetric), .2 self-admitted to being theoretical with current constants. P3 findings were design choices (forward compat) or referenced wrong file. Positive findings acknowledged. Code is well-designed.
